alternatives.name: Walkie-talkie, intercom, baby monitor
alternatives.falls_short: Muffled by masks and glass; no translation; no written record

alternatives.name: Tablet with Google Translate or video call
alternatives.price: Rs 24,249 (no-name) to Rs 41,940 (Galaxy Tab A9) or Rs 126,666 (iPad) per bed

hardware.parts: ATmega328P-PU, 16 MHz crystal, Arduino Uno bootloader, socketed
hardware.role: Runs the firmware, keypad scanning, display and link

hardware.parts: 9 V PP3 NiMH, rocker switch, 1N5819 diode, MP1584 buck at 5.0 V
hardware.role: Reverse-polarity protection and an efficient 5 V supply

hardware.parts: 74HC04 + 74HC08, S8050 driver, 940 nm LED, 33 ohm ½ W
hardware.role: Turns serial data into 38 kHz light bursts (about 100 mA pulses)
Demodulates 38 kHz light back into serial data
29,219 bytes of pre-drawn Sinhala, Tamil and English phrase images
Low-battery warning on the unit and to the Doctor Station
Beeps for new messages, requests and alarms

link.light: 940 nm LED on a 38 kHz carrier; VS1838B receiver
link.direction: Half duplex; each unit ignores its own transmission
frame_types: typed text (length, then two characters per frame)
reliability: Every frame acknowledged: Delivered or NOT delivered!
Up to 3 retries with a random back-off
Bed Units listen before talking; resend every 3 s (1.5 s for Can't breathe)
Beacon every 15 s drives the link indicator

battery.state: LOW: red light blinks, one beep, warning on screen
CRITICAL: light on, three beeps; a Bed Unit also alerts the Doctor Station
